post.summary: Read explicit same-app profile display targets
post.description: Contract only; no endpoint implemented. Projection workload checks each requested target. Hidden, missing and retired targets all return UNAVAILABLE. This is a read, never provisions profiles.

post.summary: Issue a single-use download capability for an own export
post.description: Implemented. The capability expires within five minutes, is consumed on first use, and never travels in an event.

Implemented. The capability travels in the body, never in a URL, and is single-use; expired, consumed, invalidated or erased exports are unavailable. The caller must be the same app subject as the export.

umsBearer.description: UMS-targeted app-bound authority; authentication alone does not authorize a target. IAM subject/delegation contract remains a gated dependency.
